name: Path Traversal
safe_control: Canonicalize and enforce base-directory containment.

name: OS Command Injection
safe_control: Use a fixed executable and separate argument vector; avoid a command shell.

name: Cross-site Scripting
safe_control: Apply context-appropriate HTML output encoding.

name: SQL Injection
safe_control: Use parameterized SQL and bind values.

name: LDAP Injection
safe_control: Use parameterized LDAP filters.

name: Code Injection
safe_control: Do not evaluate untrusted text as executable code.

name: HTTP Response Splitting
safe_control: Reject CR/LF in untrusted header values.

name: Sensitive Error Information
safe_control: Return a generic external error message.

name: Certificate Validation
safe_control: Use the platform trust store and default certificate validation.

name: Cleartext Transmission
safe_control: Use HTTPS/TLS for sensitive transport.

name: Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
safe_control: Supply keys through a trusted runtime/key-management boundary.

name: Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
safe_control: Use a modern approved algorithm and authenticated mode.

name: Weak Hash
safe_control: Use a modern hash appropriate for the security purpose.

name: Insufficient Randomness
safe_control: Use SecureRandom for security-sensitive randomness.

name: Signature Verification
safe_control: Enforce the boolean result of cryptographic signature verification.

name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
safe_control: Validate an anti-CSRF token before the state change.

name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
safe_control: Bound attacker-controlled resource sizes before allocation.

name: Unrestricted File Upload
safe_control: Validate type/name and store outside web-executable locations.

name: Unsafe Reflection
safe_control: Map external selectors to an explicit class allowlist.

name: Unsafe Deserialization
safe_control: Avoid native deserialization or enforce a strict object filter.

name: Sensitive Data in Logs
safe_control: Do not log secrets or credentials.

name: Open Redirect
safe_control: Restrict redirects to trusted relative paths or an allowlist.

name: XML External Entity
safe_control: Disable DTDs, external entities and external resource resolution.

name: Cookie without Secure
safe_control: Set Secure on security-sensitive HTTPS cookies.

name: XPath Injection
safe_control: Use XPath variables instead of string concatenation.

name: Hard-coded Credentials
safe_control: Load credentials from an approved secret source.

name: Missing Authorization
safe_control: Enforce authorization before the sensitive operation.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
safe_control: Enforce destination scheme/host/port allowlists.

name: Cookie without HttpOnly
safe_control: Set HttpOnly on sensitive cookies.

name: Inefficient Regular Expression
safe_control: Use a linear-time regular expression or constrain the input.
